pages.title: False Vacuum Bubble
pages.text: A pocket of space sitting in a higher-energy vacuum than its surroundings, metastable and patient. If it tunnels down to the true vacuum it will expand at nearly light speed and rewrite everything it touches. The surface ripples softly, waiting for an excuse.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Drifting through the quantum foam, I noticed bubbles whose interior energy did not match the vacuum outside. Coleman's false vacuum, right there. I have learned to give them a very wide berth.
